headline: Japan says it will bring forward its contribution to the CPI after US sanctions
summary: Japan, the largest funder of the International Criminal Court and a close US ally, said it will bring forward its contribution after US sanctions. The move addresses the court's funding after the sanctions were imposed.
why: The ICC is funded by member state contributions, and Japan is its largest donor. Sanctions and funding decisions affect international institutions and cross-border financial dealings.
original_headline: Japón dice que adelantará su contribución a la CPI tras las sanciones de Estados Unidos
